name: Stop Edge Running in the Background
description: Prevents Microsoft Edge keeping processes alive after you close its last window. This is the single biggest reason msedge.exe shows up in Task Manager on a machine nobody is browsing on.

name: Disable Edge Startup Boost
description: Stops Edge preloading itself at sign-in to shave a second off its launch time, which costs memory and a background process for the whole session.

name: Enable Sleeping Tabs
description: Lets Edge suspend tabs you have not touched, releasing their memory and CPU. The tab reloads instantly when you come back to it.

name: Disable Edge Telemetry and Metrics
description: Turns off Edge's browsing-data reporting, diagnostic uploads and site-info sharing.

name: Disable Edge Personalisation and Ad Targeting
description: Stops Edge building an advertising and content profile from your browsing to personalise ads, news and search.

name: Set Edge Tracking Prevention to Strict
description: Blocks the majority of third-party trackers in Edge. A handful of sites break; most simply load faster.

name: Block Third-Party Cookies in Edge
description: Refuses cookies set by domains other than the one in the address bar, which is the main cross-site tracking mechanism.

name: Send Do Not Track From Edge
description: Adds the Do Not Track header to Edge's requests. Sites are free to ignore it, so treat this as a statement of intent rather than a control.

name: Disable the Edge Sidebar
description: Removes the Edge sidebar and its Discover, shopping and Copilot panes.

name: Disable Copilot in Edge
description: Turns off the Copilot integration in Edge, including the page-context sharing that sends what you are reading to the model.

name: Disable the Edge Shopping Assistant
description: Turns off the coupon and price-comparison pop-ups Edge shows on retail sites, which work by sending the page you are on to Microsoft.

name: Disable Edge Collections
description: Sets the Microsoft Edge EdgeCollectionsEnabled policy value to zero to request disabling Collections. Existing organisational policies and the installed Edge version can affect the result.

name: Clean Up the Edge New Tab Page
description: Strips the MSN news feed, promoted quick links and background imagery from the new tab page, leaving just the search box.

name: Disable Edge Promotional Tabs and First-Run Page
description: Stops Edge opening tabs advertising its own features, and skips the first-run welcome experience on a new profile.

name: Stop Edge Asking to Be the Default Browser
description: Suppresses the recurring prompt asking you to make Edge your default browser.

name: Stop Edge Importing From Other Browsers
description: Prevents Edge pulling your Chrome or Firefox history, bookmarks and passwords at each launch.

name: Disable the Built-In Edge Password Manager
description: Stops Edge offering to save passwords, which is what you want if you use a dedicated password manager and do not want a second copy of your credentials in the browser profile.

name: Disable Edge Payment Card Autofill
description: Stops Edge storing and offering credit card details on checkout forms.

name: Disable Edge Address Bar Search Suggestions
description: Stops Edge sending each keystroke in the address bar to the search engine for live suggestions.

name: Enable SmartScreen in Edge
description: Keeps Edge's phishing and malicious-download protection on and stops it being overridden per site.

name: Always Use HTTPS in Edge
description: Makes Edge upgrade navigations to HTTPS and warn before falling back to plain HTTP.

name: Disable the Edge Web Widget
description: Turns off the floating Edge Bar / web widget that can be pinned to the desktop and refreshes content on its own.

name: Disable the Edge Auto-Update Scheduled Tasks
description: Disables the MicrosoftEdgeUpdate tasks that run every hour to check for browser updates. Edge then only updates when you launch it and let it.

name: Disable Internet Explorer Mode Prompts
description: Stops Edge offering to reload a page in Internet Explorer mode.

name: Disable Edge Profile Sync
description: Stops Edge syncing history, favourites, passwords and open tabs to your Microsoft account.

name: Clear Edge Browsing Data on Exit
description: Wipes history, cookies and cache each time Edge closes. You will be signed out of everything on each launch, which is the point.

name: Disable Edge Image Enhancement
description: Stops Edge sending images from pages you visit to Microsoft's servers to be upscaled and 'enhanced'.

name: Disable Edge Follow, Rewards and Related Matches
description: Turns off the creator-following, Microsoft Rewards and related-search features that each add their own background calls.

name: Disable the Internet Explorer First Run Wizard
description: Stops the legacy IE first-run wizard appearing when something on the system still invokes the old engine.

name: Stop Chrome Running in the Background
description: Prevents Google Chrome keeping processes and extensions alive after its last window closes. Only has an effect if Chrome is installed.

name: Disable Chrome Usage Metrics Reporting
description: Turns off Chrome's usage statistics and crash report uploads through policy. Only has an effect if Chrome is installed.

name: Block Third-Party Cookies in Chrome
description: Refuses cross-site cookies in Google Chrome. Only has an effect if Chrome is installed.
